coverage.method: Sitemap/navigation discovery, page-family HTML/CSS inspection, selected browser screenshots and runtime probes where permitted.
coverage.viewports: 1440px desktop and 390px mobile; not every source page was rendered.
coverage.limits: Public page families sampled, not every article, locale, private app or interaction state. Source-only theme/motion declarations are not runtime verification.

color.palette_type: monochromatic grayscale with a single blue accent; full 10-step accent scales held in reserve for state
color.observed: Home, pricing and docs landing body #fafafa with #171717 text; white panels and cards create the next surface step.
color.scale_semantics: each 10-step scale encodes intent, not just lightness: 100 default bg / 200 hover bg / 300 active bg / 400 default border / 500 hover border / 600 active border / 700 solid fill / 800 solid fill hover / 900 secondary text / 1000 primary text

accents.note: Blue marks links/focus/status; other scales support state and product/campaign material. Observed home/pricing are predominantly grayscale, not proof that every marketing route is.

color.alpha_usage: gray-alpha-* tokens are translucent and layer over any background — use for borders, dividers, overlays, hover states; solid gray-* for text and opaque fills; never swap gray-* for background-*

dark_mode.note: Source dark-theme tokens; footer offers sun/moon/system switching. This refresh did not verify the live dark state.

color.contrast_strategy: high contrast dark-on-light (or light-on-dark); hold WCAG AA 4.5:1 for body text; color signals state or hierarchy, never decoration; never state by color alone

typography.fonts: Geist Sans for marketing and UI; Geist Mono for code and selected technical annotations.
typography.marketing: Home h1 64/64, weight 400, tracking -3.84px; h2 56/56, weight 450, tracking -3.36px. Mobile h1 48/56, tracking -2.88px. Pricing h1 64/64, weight 450.
typography.product: Geist specification has a heavier 600 heading scale; copy 13/18,14/20,16/24,18/28,20/36,24/36.
typography.controls: Pricing CTA 14/21 weight 500. Current desktop hero audience list is sentence-case sans; the mobile descriptor uses mono. Do not force all marketing metadata into uppercase mono.
typography.docs: Docs landing h1 56/56, weight 600, tracking -3.36px; h2 24/32, weight 600; sidebar 14/21; body 16/24. Article titles have their own scale.

spacing.rhythm_rule: three-step rhythm: 8px inside a group, 16px between groups, 32-40px between sections
spacing.density: marketing pages are extremely airy — hero and each showcase get near-full-viewport vertical bands with huge empty margins; product UI (docs) is comfortable-compact

layout.frame: Edge-to-edge marketing bands with 24px gutters and hairline rules; product documentation uses bounded content and navigation rails.
layout.hero: Desktop: left 64px heading/CTA pair, centered halo triangle, right three-line sentence-case sans descriptor.
layout.mobile: Triangle moves above centered 48px headline; one mono descriptor and stacked full-width pill actions; logos remain a horizontal strip.
layout.showcases: Alternating text and customer-product proof, 56px headings, shipped-feature cards, centered closing CTA and multi-column footer.
layout.pricing: Three full-width columns divided by hairlines; 64px title/large prices, small plain labels, 36px pill CTAs.
layout.navigation: Compact 6px-rounded header controls; theme switcher is in footer; these differ from pill marketing CTAs.
layout.docs: Docs landing: 264px sidebar link rows, 1024px main content area at 1440px; introduction followed by three-column agent-resource cards. Guide articles add reading/navigation structure.

shape.usage_observed: 6px: nav/product/docs buttons and inputs; 12px: docs cards, menus; 16px: marketing showcase frames and 'Recently shipped' cards; 9999px (pill): ALL marketing CTAs — hero 'Deploy Now'/'Talk to Sales', pricing 'Start a free trial', /ai campaign buttons (36px tall)
shape.rule: Keep component roles consistent: rectilinear compact product controls, pill marketing actions, larger rounded media frames. Hairline grid cells and sharp badges coexist with rounded controls.
shape.border_usage: hairline 1px gray-alpha borders everywhere: card frames, logo-bar dividers, section separators, secondary buttons; borders and tonal surfaces do hierarchy before shadows

elevation.philosophy: tonal surfaces and borders first, shadows stay subtle and low-alpha; marketing screenshots float in hairline-border frames with almost no shadow
elevation.note: tooltips take the lightest shadow; pair each elevation with the matching radius

motion.philosophy: Product guidance favors short functional transitions; marketing includes an ambient canvas hero. Keep those scopes separate.
motion.easing: cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.1) — short and physical, slight overshoot
motion.durations: 150ms state changes / 200ms popovers and tooltips / 300ms overlays and modals
motion.rules: Honor reduced motion and reserve ambient work for decorative marketing; do not copy a no-loops product rule over the actual canvas scene.
motion.observed: Pricing controls transition 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); hero canvas has a 1200ms opacity transition class.

components.button_primary_product: solid gray-1000 (#171717) fill, white label, button-14 (14px/500), 6px radius, 32-40px height (verified nav Sign Up: 32px)
components.button_secondary_product: white fill, hairline gray-alpha border, primary text, 6px radius (verified nav Get a Demo / Log In)
components.button_marketing_cta: pill (9999px), 36px height — dark fill + white text for primary, white fill + hairline border for secondary; hero pair 'Deploy Now'/'Talk to Sales'
components.button_error: solid red-800 #ea001d fill, white text, destructive only
components.input: background-100 fill, translucent border, 6px radius, 40px height; docs search: 6px-radius field with ⌘K keycap hint
components.state_stepping: hover/active step up the scale: fill 100→200→300, border 400→500→600
components.disabled: gray-100 fill, gray-700 text, not-allowed cursor
components.badges_observed: 'NEW'/'POPULAR': tiny Geist Mono uppercase text in a 1px hairline box, sharp-ish corners; 'Beta' (docs): blue-100 bg pill with blue-700 text
components.pricing_cards: full-bleed white 3-column band separated by hairlines (not floating cards); plan name 14px, giant 64px price at display weight, hairline rule, then 14px feature list with 16px stroke icons, pill CTA at bottom
components.blog_cards: white cards on #fafafa, date + gray category meta line, 32px weight-450 title, excerpt, overlapping avatar cluster + author names; pill category filter tabs + search field above
components.code_blocks_docs: white bg, hairline border, 12px radius, filename tab header with copy button; syntax: magenta/pink keywords, green strings, blue types on white
components.terminal_demos_marketing: inset panels inside cards: mono 13-14px, ✓ checkmark lines in green, 'Production:' URL lines, dark or light variants

design_style.mood: Precise grayscale infrastructure; tightly tracked Geist statements and engineering metadata.
design_style.composition: Asymmetric three-part hero on desktop becomes a vertical triangle/headline/actions stack on mobile. Full-width hairline bands and generous whitespace organize proof.
design_style.imagery: Customer product surfaces, terminal transcripts, line drawings and a monumental monochrome triangle; colored campaign/product details remain possible outside the sampled homepage.
design_style.interaction: Fast state changes in compact controls; ambient hero animation is a deliberately separate marketing layer.

visual_effects.technology: Homepage has one canvas. Current source uses Canvas 2D for triangle/halo drawing; no need to introduce a WebGL scene to reproduce this hero.
visual_effects.hero: Theme-aware triangle and grainy halo; 1200ms canvas opacity transition. Buffer is 2160×1440 in the 1440px sample and 585×600 at 390px; buffer size is not CSS layout size.
visual_effects.scroll: Below-fold content appears as approached; do not claim all motion is prohibited because the product-system text favors restrained transitions.
visual_effects.controls: Pricing buttons use 150ms transitions; compact controls use hairline borders and shadows, not universal flatness.
visual_effects.scope: Light home/pricing rendered; dark tokens and design.dark.md refreshed from source. No live dark-mode verification claimed in this pass.
visual_effects.docs: No canvas/video in sampled docs landing; scroll-linked sidebar top/bottom fade animations use automatic timeline duration.

page_families./home: Large asymmetric hero, 2D triangle, customer proof and shipped-feature cards.
page_families./pricing: Three ruled columns rather than floating cards; lower cost-control and comparison content.
page_families./docs: Technical navigation/search, reading rail, code/copy components; heavier product typography.
page_families./ai: Campaign surface with its own diagram/grid compositions.
page_families./design.md; /design.dark.md: Published Geist guidance and theme references; token guidance must be distinguished from live marketing overrides.
